poses.caption: Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and knees relaxed outward. Hold your ankles or feet, breathe steadily and let the inner thighs stretch gently.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1494 BUTTERFLY YOGA POSE. ONE STATIC HOLD exactly ONE full body person seated on thin gray mat, FRONT three-quarter view showing both inner thighs. Pelvis grounded torso TALL upright neutral spine shoulders down neck long eyes forward. BOTH knees BENT and OPEN outward symmetrically to sides, soles of BOTH SHOES pressed TOGETHER centered in FRONT of pelvis, heels pulled comfortably toward body. Feet not crossed, both ankles separate connected only sole-to-sole. BOTH hands gently hold ankles/feet, elbows relaxed bent no forced knee pressure. Knees relaxed downward near floor not forced flat, visible natural bent leg geometry. Primary BILATERAL INNER THIGH ADDUCTORS RED: exposed distal inner thigh red fine anatomy; covered proximal INNER thigh only soft DIFFUSE red teaching tint over intact black shorts. NOT quads/glutes/calves. Cloth smooth opaque broad normal folds, NEVER fibers or muscle lobes through fabric. Fine detailed grayscale other exposed anatomy realistic fingers feet proportions. Complete opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK and BLACK MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH with continuous crotch fabric and hems, no gaps or cutaway/transparency when knees open, seams broad cloth folds. Black athletic shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins full head hands both knees soles mat entirely inside SQUARE uncropped. Equal male/female quality. Original project reference rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup/chest red. No text labels captions arrows extra panels.
